verdicts.reason: A shrinks the SOLSTICE logo and wordmark to near-illegible specks. Its CTA breaks into three lines, leaving 'Line' orphaned on its own line, and it is almost as heavy as the headline, so headline and CTA compete; the CTA is also jammed against the bottom edge. B keeps the logo readable and sets the CTA in two cleaner lines. However, B's headline is pushed almost to the side edges with very thin margins, the CTA is still oversized relative to the original's subtle text link, and the bottom spacing is tight.
